purpose: Bounded edges between catalogue concepts: competition, complementarity, context divergence, measurable gaps. No new theory synthesis automatically accepted.
governance: Evidence link reports retain their original task scale and result; edges do not upgrade frozen PESEN v0.1.
Avoid double counting the same source observations across related research IDs.
Different targets, outcomes, scoring and holdout units prevent direct cross-study pooled effects.
Potential personal decision usefulness is a future testable bridge, not instruction to build personal system now.

edges.knowledge: DeGroot unconditional peer averaging versus FJ stubbornness; simulation differences do not establish human psychological law.
FJ stubbornness versus HK bounded confidence, different conditions and dynamical predictions.
Threshold-neighbor fraction vs independent one-shot edge transmission require different individual exposure; real causal classification unverified.
IC edge transmission versus Bass aggregate adoption curve operate at different scales; not substitutable by shared score without common observable.
Empirical/normative expectation measurement is not equivalent to publicly broadcast reputation or sanction, even if models share terms.

Four-person PGG peer-lag underperforms equal shrink, whereas genuine dyadic PD actual-partner lag improves Brier over shrink; different targets, units and rewards, not logical conflict or pooled effect.
Model-free imitation/reinforcement learning may explain observed prior partner dependence, but history-prediction gain does not identify imitation parameters or causal learning.
Same-source Brier should be paired with equal shrink and rotated-donor placebo; placebo may not truly exclude a real dyad without original partner IDs.
Holdout original laboratory session reduces within-study leakage; distinct newly recruited cohort with different model/game is not exact frozen-model external replication.
Brier improvement from opponent history cannot separate social influence, selection, stable types, common environment or observation opportunity.
Values, contradictions and preference drift require later measurement/feedback; no personal system or private health data acquisition authorized.
Institutional path-dependence and long-run macro simulation can be linked only after micro-to-institution variables, exogenous assumptions and time-series validation.
